note: Alt text for each aperture art piece. The same text goes on the light and dark image. Pages and the publication builder read it from here.

alt.cover-a-witness-should-not-become-a-rule: An eye drawn in fine lines, its iris a glowing ring around a bright core, above a thin horizon.
alt.cover-articulate: Rows of short dashes, like lines of text, bend around a bright circle on the right. On the left, one run of dashes lifts out of its line in orange, bracketed at both ends.
alt.cover-availability-is-not-reach: A bright source at the left throws a widening cone of dots across the dark, thinning as it spreads.
alt.cover-borrowed-ground: A bright sun low over a flat horizon, with two thin rust-colored towers standing to its left.
alt.cover-briefing-openai-hugging-face-incid: A bright core inside nested square frames, with a band of fine lines running out to the right edge.
alt.cover-checking-the-machines: A grid of small square drawings, each a set of nested squares knocked slightly out of true. One cell near the right holds a glowing ring.
alt.cover-dossier: A six-armed crystal of fine lines, like a snowflake, with a bright core at its center.
alt.cover-frontier-safety: A bright core ringed by fifty-two fine tick marks, one of them drawn long past the outer rings.
alt.cover-frontier-safety-openai-hugging-fac: A bright core inside a striped sphere, with horizontal bars sliding across it.
alt.cover-growth-needs-a-before: Rings drawn in fine lines around a bright core, with a small bracket measuring one ring against another.
alt.cover-ltj-bukem-the-man-behind-the-atmos: A soft glowing orb hangs over a field of short woven strokes, like sound drawn as texture.
alt.cover-models-propose-oracles-dispose: Hundreds of tangled lines from the left converge on one bright point and leave it as a few straight rays.
alt.cover-no-receipt-no-accept: A halftone sphere cut by a vertical strip where the dots give way to scanlines, with a perforated edge like a receipt.
alt.cover-pick-the-lock-for-everyone: A glowing keyhole set into layered bands of wavy lines.
alt.cover-pick-the-lock-for-everyone-talk: A glowing keyhole set into layered bands of wavy lines that ripple near its center.
alt.cover-resume: A contour map drawn in fine lines, with a dotted route climbing from the lower left across the hills to a bright core at the highest summit.
alt.cover-the-sandbox-was-never-just-a-box: A wireframe cube drawn in fine lines, with a bright core inside it and light leaking through one face.
alt.cover-the-second-hearing: A large disc of fine lines with two bright points side by side near its center.
alt.cover-the-summary-is-not-the-record: Rows of wavy horizontal lines, with one bright glow where the lines bunch together.
alt.cover-what-the-label-changes: Fields of fine wavy lines bend around a bright core, with a small framed label in the lower right.
alt.domain-agent-systems: A bright core inside a ring, joined by curved bundles of fine lines to five small rings around it, with dashed lines linking the small rings to each other.
alt.domain-developer-infrastructure: Rows of horizontal lines lifted over a hidden stepped platform, so the terraces show as steps in the lines, with a bright core on the top tier.
alt.domain-evaluation-verification: A test chart: a star of alternating wedges drawn in close arcs around a bright core, with scale marks on four sides and a stepped strip of tones below.
alt.domain-graphics-media: Parallel lines pass through a lens drawn in fine lines and gather at a bright point, then spread out past it, with one small fan of spectrum colors.
alt.domain-research-education: A branching growth like frost or coral spreading outward in fine lines from a bright core at the center.
alt.domain-security-privacy: A diamond lattice with every other cell filled with fine lines, bulging outward as if seen through a lens, with a bright core in the one open cell at the center.
alt.home-hero: A sun drawn in fine lines sits on the horizon over a perspective grid. Two thin towers stand in the haze, and the sun's reflection breaks into short bars on the grid below.
alt.pillar-flywheel: A bright core inside a large ring of fine radial lines, like a wheel drawn with a plotter pen.
alt.pillar-fonts: A bright core inside a thick tilted ring, like a letter O drawn in fine lines.
alt.pillar-research: A halftone sphere lit from one side, floating over a field of faint wavy lines.
alt.pillar-security: An iris shutter drawn in fine hatched blades, closed down to a small hole with a bright core showing through it, inside a ringed housing.
alt.pillar-studio: A bright core inside a ring that breaks into offset slices, like a glitching signal.
alt.pillar-systems: A square chip at the center with its pins fanned out on all four sides as thin routed traces, each ending in a small pad, and a bright core inside the chip.
alt.pillar-who-knew-first: A bright core at the left with faint rings around it, and small scattered marks drifting across the dark to the right.
alt.pillar-work: A bright core inside a dial of rings, beside a panel of sliders and gauges.
alt.pillar-writing: A fan of ruled sheets drawn in fine lines, the top sheet lit by a bright core.
